items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: he took [(prose)] from one of our organists in the church, a Professor Keaton

ctx.x: No, Harold was in school about three years or so behind me so he was definitely in school then, but he later on became first interested in pipe organ. And he took

from one of our organists in the church, a Professor Keaton, who was in Oakland. And finally -- I don't remember just how the situation culminated, but he finally sought of went in professionally too. And he went his way and I went my way.

Of course we weren't living together then anyway. So the family went our different ways -- all in music, except the older one who was by this time well in the Post Office -- Postal Service in Oakland.
